dominant_strengths: Editorial hero photography with strong cinematic lighting creates immediate aspirational pull and brand-fitting premium automotive mood
Restrained typographic system with confident serif-free wordmark and clean sans hierarchy reads as deliberate and quietly luxurious
Cookie modal is well-typeset with clear primary/secondary action ladder and legible legal copy
dominant_weaknesses: Cookie consent dialog dominates lower-left while hero headline competes above, fracturing the composition into two unrelated focal zones
Translucent navigation bar muddies contrast over the bright sky region, making 'Demo drive' CTA feel weak rather than confident
Floating yellow accessibility orb clashes chromatically with the muted blue-green automotive palette and breaks the otherwise restrained system
fix_priorities: Defer or miniaturize cookie modal so hero narrative reads first; use a slim bottom banner instead of a blocking card
Strengthen nav contrast with a subtle scrim or darker glass so wordmark and CTA hold their weight over varied imagery
Recolor or restyle the floating accessibility widget to harmonize with the brand's earthy/utility palette
Tighten hero text block — current line-break and CTA placement feel obscured by overlapping UI chrome
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral pull from hero imagery, but behavioral clarity is undercut by the blocking consent layer and reflective brand depth never fully lands.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads unmistakably as Rivian and reinforces premium-adventure EV positioning, but the executional layering of overlays dilutes what should be a singular, decisive landing moment.
